notes.title: Bravada at PAX 2014 and 'Best RPG/Adventure' in Intel's annual 'Level-Up' competition
notes.content:
Bravada has been chosen for 'Best RPG/Adventure' in Intel's annual 'Level-Up' competition! Bravada will be presented at PAX Prime in Intel's booth - Feel free to visit, try the game, and get a free Steam key.
Unfortunately, we are unable to visit Seatle and show Bravada personally because of war activity in our country the Ukraine.

notes.title: 2014 Intel Level Up Game Developer Contest Winners Announced
notes.content:
Intel® today announced the nine winning teams for the 2014 Intel® Level Up Game Developer Contest, each being offered worldwide distribution via Steam!

The 2014 Intel® Level Up Game Developer Contest asks game developers to submit their playable proofs of concept, alphas, betas, and unreleased demos for a chance to win cash prizes and ultimately be distributed via Steam. The categories, winners, and links to where you can find the games on Steam, can be found on the 2014 Intel® Level Up Contest Hall of Fame.

You can read full details of the contest over on the official Intel® Level Up Game Developer Contest.
